$comment: echo_v1 vectors, HAND-WRITTEN 2026-11-18 before any code or run (docs/plans/v2-improvements.md, 'echo_v1 rule, pre-registered'). 'expected' is whether the rule fires on a reply the guard passed. Words come from rank_v1's question_terms (AND_V2_STOPWORDS + rank_stopwords_v1 dropped; tokens with a digit or of one code point dropped), each replaced by plural_alternative when it has one. Never regenerate from the implementation.

cases.name: E1: restates the question (q08-like)
cases.question: Which items are included in the campus ban on plastics?
cases.reply: The campus ban on plastics includes items.
cases.why: Q {item, included, campus, ban, plastic}; R {campus, ban, plastic, include, item}; new {include} = 1

cases.name: E2: restates, then adds the answer
cases.question: Who publishes the outing notice?
cases.reply: The outing notice is published by the Office of the Secretary General.
cases.why: Q {publishe, outing, notice}; new {published, by, office, secretary, general} = 5

cases.name: E3: three new words
cases.question: Which office published the outing notice?
cases.reply: The office that published the outing notice is the Secretary General.

cases.name: E4: a correct two-word answer counts as an echo (recorded risk)
cases.question: Which office published the outing notice?
cases.reply: The Secretary General published the outing notice.

cases.name: E5: a new date is never an echo
cases.question: When is the outing?
cases.why: reply date (5, 14) and number 2027 are not in the question

cases.name: E6: a yes/no restatement with the question's own date (recorded risk)
cases.question: Is there an outing on May 14, 2027?
cases.reply: There is an outing on May 14, 2027.
cases.why: dates {(5, 14)} and numbers {2027} are subsets; words {outing} vs {outing}; new 0

cases.name: E7: a new number is never an echo
cases.question: How many water stations are there?
cases.why: number 40 is not in the question

cases.name: E8: a bare yes counts as an echo (recorded risk)
cases.question: Can I bring a tumbler?

cases.name: E9: Taglish with a new date
cases.question: Kailan ang pasok sa second term?
cases.reply: Ang pasok sa second term ay sa January 15, 2027.

cases.name: E10: a Taglish pure echo
cases.question: Pwede ba mag-sleeveless sa campus?
cases.why: Q {pwede, mag, sleeveless, campus}; R the same; new 0

cases.name: E11: a Taglish echo followed by the answer
cases.question: Pwede ba mag-sleeveless sa campus?
cases.reply: Pwede mag-sleeveless sa campus? The dress code prohibits sleeveless tops.
cases.why: new {dress, code, prohibit, tops} = 4 ('tops' has 4 code points, so no plural alternative)

cases.name: E12: plurals normalised on both sides
cases.question: What are the uniform rules?
cases.why: Q {uniform, rule}; R {uniform, rule, applie}; new {applie} = 1

cases.name: E13: three new words after the restatement
cases.question: What are the uniform rules?
cases.reply: Uniform rules require Type A polo.
cases.why: new {require, type, polo} = 3 ('a' is a stopword)
